summary: This informational document describes ways to support multicast listeners in Proxy Mobile IPv6 domains without changing the mobility or multicast standards. The Local Mobility Anchor acts as the multicast anchor, and Mobile Access Gateways handle listener signaling. It shows how to deploy existing parts together.

eli5.summary: When your phone moves between network access points, you still want shared broadcasts like TV. This explains how to arrange existing pieces so that keeps working.

questions: how do mobile nodes receive multicast in pmipv6
